info.text:
Target has booked about $1.3 billion in tariff refunds over two quarters (our math: $994M in Q2 + $301M in Q3).
Q3 (reported Nov 18): $301M pretax refund benefit, adding $0.50 to EPS of $2.65.
Net sales still rose 7.1% to about $27.1B.
Importers paid about $166B in the struck-down emergency tariffs, and refunds are flowing back to them. Shoppers can't file. FedEx and UPS say they'll pass duty-fee refunds to customers once CBP pays them.
Sources: Target Q3 and Q2 releases, CBP court filings, CBS News.
News and education, not financial advice.
